latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "use-circle-wallets" skill.
- Provides a comprehensive comparison of Circle wallet types: developer-controlled, user-controlled, and modular (passkey).
- Includes decision guide and implementation patterns for choosing the right custody model, key management, and account types.
- Outlines strict rules for wallet selection and integration best practices.
- Offers quick scenario-based recommendations and direct links to official Circle documentation.
